cohort: 716 women who underwent transvaginal ultrasonography early in pregnancy (<8 weeks) and 3-6 months postpartum
finding: While both cesarean and vaginal delivery led to an increased proportion of women with a retroflexed uterus postpartum, the prevalence of CSD did not differ between women with anteflexed and retroflexed uteri.
mod_finding: Cesarean section resulted in a significantly greater proportion of retroflexed uteri postpartum compared to vaginal delivery.
